# Runs dashboard and Start run drawer (GMD-06, GMD-07) ## What to build Rebuild `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` as the landing page of the design (boards `05-runs-dashboard-light-start-run-open`, `06-runs-dashboard-dark`, and the RUNS / START RUN states on `19-empty-loading-error-dialogs-light`), on top of `useOverview()`. Add the server data it needs: - each run's PR link and a short failure reason - a workspace inspection endpoint for the Start run drawer - the CLI's exit code and output on a failed start **Page layout:** - **Header:** "Runs", ``, and a primary **Start run** button showing `s`. The `s` key opens the drawer too, as does `?start=1` in the URL. - **``** under the header. - **Four cards:** - **Live**: the number of runs with `live: true` or status `running`, with the sub-line `N runs · M suite(s)`. - **Failed**: the number of runs with status `failed`, with the sub-line ` · ` of the newest failed run. - **Ready for PR**: status `applied` and no `pr`, with "applied, no PR yet". - **Terminals idle**: the number of terminals with status `idle`, with "agents waiting on you →", linking to `/terminals?filter=idle`. Each card filters the table when clicked (`?status=live|failed|ready`) and shows its active state. The terminals card navigates instead. - **Filters row:** - **Workspace** select: "All workspaces" plus every workspace, synced with `?workspace=`. - **Text filter:** placeholder "Filter by run id, provider…" with a `/` kbd hint and the `data-filter` attribute. It matches the id and provider. - **Group by workspace** checkbox, default on, saved in `localStorage["gm.runs.group"]`. - **Table:** columns Status | Run | Type | Provider | Tasks merged | Created ↓ | Action. - **Status:** ``. - **Run:** the id in mono, plus `` when `live`. - **Type:** `run`, or `suite` in the rev tone. - **Provider:** mono. - **Tasks merged:** `merged/total` and `` in the run's tone. Empty for suites without counts. - **Created:** relative time. - **Action:** - **Create PR**: a small secondary button for applied runs without a PR. It goes to `/runs//#pr`. - `PR #N ↗` / `MR !N ↗`: an external link when the run has a PR. - The failure reason as muted text for failed runs, e.g. "validation failed". - **Grouped mode:** a group header row per workspace with: - `` - the full path in mono bold - a branch icon and the branch - a `dirty` (warn) or `clean` (ok) chip - "N runs" - an **Open terminal** link at the right → `/terminals?workspace=` Ungrouped mode is one flat list. - **Sorting by attention:** failed and live (or running) first, then ready for PR, then the rest. Each bucket is sorted by createdAt, newest first. Groups are ordered by their most urgent run. - **Keyboard:** `useListNav` over the visible rows. The focused row has the accent outline from the board. Enter opens the run, and `p` on a focused ready row opens `/runs//#pr`. - **Footer note:** "Sorted by attention: failed and live first, then ready for PR, then the rest by created time. j/k to move, Enter to open, p to create a PR on the focused row." (`Kbd`s inline). - **First load:** ``, while `!loaded`. - **Empty state** (no runs at all): "No runs yet", "Runs started from a terminal show up here on their own. You can also start one here.", a mono command chip `graph-execution .agents/tasks --spec docs/prd.md --web`, and a **Start run** button. - Board 19 shows `graph-execution run --spec …`, which is not the CLI's syntax. Use the real one: `graph-execution --spec `. - **Start run drawer** (``): - **Workspace** select. Defaults to `?workspace=` or the first workspace. Under it, ` · N uncommitted file(s)` from inspect. - **Tasks folder** input, default `.agents/tasks`. Under it, "N task files found", or "No task files found" / "Not a folder in this workspace" in the bad tone. Comes from inspect, debounced 300ms. - **Spec path** input, placeholder `docs/prd.md`, hint "Markdown PRD, relative to the workspace root". A missing file shows "File not found" in bad. - **Provider** ``: claude, codex, opencode, qwen, fake. `fake` is labelled "fake (test)". Defaults to the last used (`localStorage["gm.provider"]`), else claude. - **Will run:** a dark mono block with the exact command: ``` graph-execution \ --spec \ --provider

\ --web ``` This is the real argument order the server uses, which is what matters, even where it differs from the board. - **Footer:** **Cancel** and a primary **Start run** with `Ctrl ↵`. Ctrl+Enter submits. - **On success:** close the drawer, `refresh()` the overview, and toast "Started run " with an Open action → `/runs//`. - **On error:** a red box under the Spec path field. Its title is "graph-execution exited with code N" when the server sent `exitCode`, else the error text. The body shows `output` (or `error`) in mono, as on board 19 "START RUN · CLI ERROR". ## Context: files to read before implementing - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx` (210 lines) and `Runs.test.tsx`: the current page and tests. Replace both. - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/runs.ts`: `relativeTime`, `taskProgress`, `workspaceLabel` (`github~octo~hello` → `github/octo/hello`). The repo name is the last path segment. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts`: - lines 17–31: `RunSummary` - lines 87–110: `summarize(ws, entry, state?)` - line 128: `listRuns(workspacesDir)` - line 117: `listWorkspaceRuns(ws)` - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts`: - lines 54–63: `GET /api/runs` - lines 73–107: `POST /api/runs/:ws` (start). It uses `insideWorkspace(ws, rel)` (lines 35–43) and returns 400 `{error: lastLines(output, 20)}` when the CLI exits non-zero. - `PROVIDERS` (line 12). - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/store.ts` (lines 18–24): `prs` records keyed `${workspaceId}/${runId}` → `{url, number, branch, forge, createdAt}`. - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/app.ts` (lines 76–83): where feature routes are registered, one line each. - Engine: `import { readViewJson } from "graph-execution/api"` (added by the engine task) returns `ViewJson | undefined` with: - `nodes: Record` - `gate?: {status}`, `agents.{reviewer,tester,fixer,gateFixer}?: {status}`, `merge?: {status}` - `summary?: {exitCode, abort?: {step, message}, merge?: {target, ok, reason?}}` - `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.test.ts`, `routes/runs.test.ts`: the server test patterns (temp workspaces with a fake `.graph-execution//state.json`). - The boards: `05-…png/.html` (exact layout, card styles, table, group rows, drawer) and `06-…png` (dark). ## Step-by-step tasks ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` - Add to `RunSummary`: - `pr?: { url: string; number: number; forge: "github" | "gitlab" }` - `failure?: string` - `listRuns(workspacesDir, prs?: Record)` and `listWorkspaceRuns(ws, prs?)` set `pr` from `prs[`${ws.id}/${id}`]`. - For a run with status `failed` or `aborted`, set `failure` from `readViewJson(entry.dir)`. Short labels: - gate node failed → "validation failed" - a task node failed → "task failed" - reviewer/tester/fixer failed → "review failed" - merge failed → "apply failed" - `summary.abort` → ` failed` - status `aborted` with nothing else → "aborted" - otherwise undefined - The route passes `ctx.store.get().prs`. ### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/inspect.ts` (+ register in `app.ts`, + `inspect.test.ts`) - `GET /api/workspaces/:id/inspect?tasksDir=&spec=` → `{ branch: string; changes: number; tasksDir?: { exists: boolean; taskFiles: number }; spec?: { exists: boolean } }`. - **changes:** the number of lines of `git status --porcelain -- . ':(exclude).graph-execution'`. Mirror `pr.ts`'s note: stage-free, just status. - **taskFiles:** the number of `*.json` files directly in the folder, except `test-plan.json`. - **Paths:** resolved the same way as `insideWorkspace()` in `routes/runs.ts`. Copy that helper or export it. - 404 for an unknown workspace. A path that escapes the workspace gives `exists: false`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/runs.ts` (+ tests) - A failing start answers 400 `{ error, exitCode, output }`: - `output` is the last 20 lines of combined output. - `error` keeps today's text, so old tests still pass. - `GET /api/runs` passes `prs`. ### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/types.ts` - Add `pr?` and `failure?` to `RunSummary`. ### REWRITE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.tsx`, CREATE `pages/Runs.css`, `pages/StartRunDrawer.tsx` - As described above. Use only `ui/` components, tokens and the base classes. - Use `` for PR links. ### REWRITE `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/Runs.test.tsx`; ADD `StartRunDrawer.test.tsx` - **Runs:** - Attention sort order (failed, live, ready, rest). - Grouping on and off. - The text filter. - `?status=failed` shows only failed runs. - Action cells: Create PR, a `PR #3` link, "validation failed". - The empty state. - j/k moves `.focused`, and Enter navigates. - **StartRunDrawer:** - Inspect results render ("7 task files found", "main · 2 uncommitted files"). - The command preview updates with the provider. - Ctrl+Enter posts `{tasksDir, spec, provider}` to `/api/runs/`. - A 400 with `exitCode: 2` shows "graph-execution exited with code 2" and the output. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] With a fake run applied in a cloned workspace, the Runs page shows it in its workspace group with an `applied` badge and **Create PR**. A running fake run (`task:4` hang script, see `TESTING.md`) sorts above it with a `live` dot and a blue progress bar. - [ ] **Start run** with provider `fake (test)`, tasks folder `diamond` and spec `spec.md` starts a run that appears within 5 s. - [ ] A spec that doesn't exist shows the server's reason in the red box. - [ ] `GET /api/workspaces//inspect?tasksDir=diamond&spec=spec.md` returns the task file count and `spec.exists: true`. - [ ] Light and dark screenshots at 1440×1150 match boards 05 and 06. At 900px the table turns into two-line rows and nothing overflows horizontally (`document.documentElement.scrollWidth - innerWidth` → 0). - [ ] `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager` pass. ## Validation commands ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test -w graph-manager -- Runs StartRun runs inspect npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager # then agent-browser on /runs ``` --- ## Shared context (same in every task of this run) **Repo.** npm-workspaces monorepo. The engine is `packages/graph-execution` (published CLI, library entry `graph-execution/api` = `packages/graph-execution/src/api.ts`). The product is `apps/graph-manager`: Fastify 5 server in `src/server/`, React 19 + react-router 7 + Vite UI in `src/web/`, tests with vitest (server: `fastify.inject` via `src/server/test-helpers.ts`; UI: `// @vitest-environment jsdom` + `@testing-library/react` with `fetch` stubbed by `vi.stubGlobal`, see `src/web/App.test.tsx`). The spec is `docs/prd/graph-manager-design.md`. **The design.** `docs/design/graph-manager/` holds every board of the design as `NN-name.png` (screenshot, open it with your image-reading tool and LOOK at it), `NN-name.txt` (all its text) and `NN-name.html` (its real HTML/CSS, fonts stripped; copy measurements, colors and structure from here). Boards: `00-ia-proposal-react-notes`, `01-design-system`, `02-component-nav-rail`, `03-login-light`, `04-login-dark`, `05-runs-dashboard-light-start-run-open`, `06-runs-dashboard-dark`, `07-terminals-light-2-2-split`, `08-terminals-dark`, `09-terminals-800-px`, `10-run-detail-live-light`, `11-run-detail-live-dark`, `12-run-detail-finished-800-px`, `13-run-detail-landed-create-pr-light`, `14-run-detail-landed-create-pr-dark`, `15-workspaces-clone-light`, `16-workspaces-clone-dark`, `17-settings-forges-light`, `18-settings-forges-dark`, `19-empty-loading-error-dialogs-light`, `20-empty-loading-error-dialogs-dark`. Mock data in the boards (octo/hello, dev-vm-01, counts) is illustrative: show real data from the API. Where a board shows something impossible with real data, keep the layout and use real values. **Shared UI contracts.** Tasks run in parallel, so everyone uses these exact names. Task 2 creates the `ui/` kit, task 3 creates the shell, overview and keys; later tasks only consume them (and may add optional fields to shared types in place). - `apps/graph-manager/src/web/ui/tokens.css`: CSS variables `--bg --sf --sf2 --bd --bd2 --fg --fg2 --fg3 --ac --acbg --term --termfg` (values from `01-design-system`), status tones `--live --live-bg --ok --ok-bg --warn --warn-bg --bad --bad-bg --mute --mute-bg --rev --rev-bg`, `--space-1`…`--space-8` (4 8 12 16 20 24 32 48 px), `--radius-sm/md/lg` (4/6/10), `--control-h` 36px, `--control-h-dense` 32px, `--row-h` 40px, `--nav-w` 232px, `--rail-w` 56px, `--dur-fast` 120ms, `--dur-base` 180ms, `--font-sans` (Geist Variable, system-ui…), `--font-mono` (Geist Mono Variable, ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas). Light on `:root`, dark on `:root[data-theme="dark"]`. Components use only `var(--…)`, never hex. - `ui/base.css` (imported once in `main.tsx`): global classes `.btn` (+ `.btn-primary`, `.btn-danger`, `.btn-ghost`, `.btn-sm`), `.input`, `.select`, `.textarea`, `.field` (`.field-label`, `.field-hint`, `.field-error`), `.card`, `.table` with `.table-row` / `.table-row.focused` / `.table-group`, `.chip`, `.mono`, `.num` (tabular-nums), `.muted`, `.page`, `.page-header`. Focus ring: 2px `var(--ac)` outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. - `ui/status.ts`: `type Tone = "live" | "ok" | "warn" | "bad" | "mute" | "rev"`, `type Glyph = "pulse" | "dot" | "ring" | "dashed" | "diamond" | "bar" | "half"`, `toneOf(kind: "run" | "task" | "term", value: string, exitCode?: number): Tone`, `glyphOf(kind, value, exitCode?): Glyph`. Mapping: run running→live/pulse, applied→ok/dot, done→mute/ring, aborted→mute/bar, failed→bad/diamond, review→rev/half; task running|validating|merging→live/pulse, merged→ok/dot, failed→bad/diamond, pending→mute/dashed; term working→live/pulse, idle→warn/half, exited with 0→mute/ring, exited with ≠0→bad/diamond. - `ui/StatusBadge.tsx`: `` renders `>` with the glyph and `label ?? value` (term exited shows `exited `). Also exports `` and `` (blue pulsing dot + "live"). - `ui/Icon.tsx`: ``, inline SVG, `currentColor`. Names: `logo runs terminal folder settings search plus close external moon sun monitor logout chevron-left chevron-right chevron-down branch maximize layout-1 layout-2 layout-4 info git refresh`. - `ui/Drawer.tsx`: `` right-side panel (360px; full width under 900px), Esc closes, focus goes back to the opener. - `ui/Dialog.tsx`: `` (role `dialog`, Esc = cancel, shows `Esc` kbd on Cancel). - `ui/Segmented.tsx`: `` (role `radiogroup`, buttons role `radio`). - `ui/Kbd.tsx` `Ctrl K`; `ui/ForgeChip.tsx` `` (mono caps chip GITHUB/GITLAB); `ui/Skeleton.tsx` ``; `ui/EmptyState.tsx` ``; `ui/Progress.tsx` ``. - `ui/toast.tsx`: `` and `useToast(): { show(t: { tone: "ok" | "bad" | "live"; text: string; action?: { label: string; to?: string; onClick?: () => void } }): void }`. Bottom-right stack, auto-dismiss after 6 s. - `ui/theme.ts`: `type ThemePref = "system" | "light" | "dark"`, `getThemePref()`, `setThemePref(p)` (`localStorage["gm.theme"]`, every access in try/catch), `applyTheme()` (sets `document.documentElement.dataset.theme` to the resolved `light`/`dark`, follows `matchMedia("(prefers-color-scheme: dark)")` while `system`), `useTheme(): { pref, setPref, resolved }`. - `src/web/types.ts`: the client copies of the API shapes: `RunSummary`, `TerminalInfo`, `WorkspaceEntry`, `ForgesInfo`. Add optional fields in place when your task adds them on the server. - `src/web/overview.tsx`: `` and `useOverview(): { runs: RunSummary[]; terminals: TerminalInfo[]; workspaces: WorkspaceEntry[]; workspacesRoot?: string; forges: ForgesInfo; loaded: boolean; updatedAt?: number; failures: number; stale: boolean; refresh(): Promise }`. It polls `GET /api/runs`, `/api/terminals`, `/api/workspaces`, `/api/forges` every 2 s with `Promise.allSettled`, pauses while `document.hidden`, keeps the last good data, and sets `stale` after 3 failed polls in a row. Also `` ("updated 1s ago", amber when stale) and `` ("Can't reach the server. Showing data from 14s ago. Retrying…"). - `src/web/keys.ts`: `useKey(combo, handler, opts?: { enabled?: boolean; allowInInput?: boolean })` with combos like `"s"`, `"p"`, `"/"`, `"Escape"`, `"Ctrl+k"`, `"Ctrl+Enter"`; `isTypingTarget(el)` (input, textarea, select, contenteditable, or inside `.xterm`); `useListNav(count, { onOpen(i) }): [index, setIndex]` (j/k/Enter, ignored while typing). The shell handles `g r|t|w|s`, `Ctrl+k`, and `/` (focuses the first `[data-filter]` element on the page). - Routes and query strings: `/runs?status=failed|live|ready&workspace=`, `/runs/:ws/:runId`, `/terminals?workspace=` (opens a new terminal there), `?focus=`, `?filter=working|idle|other`, `?run=/` (opens that run in a pane), `/workspaces?clone=1` (opens the clone drawer), `/settings`. Page roots keep `data-testid="page-runs" | "page-terminals" | "page-workspaces" | "page-settings" | "page-run-detail" | "page-login"`. - Each page keeps its CSS in its own file next to it (`pages/Runs.css` imported by `pages/Runs.tsx`), so parallel tasks don't edit one stylesheet. **Look at what you build.** For any UI change, build and run graph-manager and look at it in a real browser with `agent-browser` (installed globally; run `agent-browser skills get core` once if you need its command reference): ```bash npm run build -w graph-execution && npm run build -w graph-manager GM_DIR=$(mktemp -d) node apps/graph-manager/scripts/fake-forge.mjs 7421 $GM_DIR/forge & # fake GitHub/GitLab; tokens gh-good / gl-good GM_PASSWORD=pw GM_PORT=7420 GM_DATA_DIR=$GM_DIR/data GM_WORKSPACES_DIR=$GM_DIR/ws \ GM_GITHUB_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:7421/github node apps/graph-manager/dist/server/main.js & agent-browser open http://127.0.0.1:7420/ && agent-browser snapshot -i agent-browser set viewport 1440 900 && agent-browser screenshot /tmp/gm.png # then open /tmp/gm.png and compare it with the board ``` Use another port if 7420/7421 are taken. Log in with `pw`. Check light and dark (`agent-browser eval 'document.documentElement.dataset.theme'`). Start runs with `--provider fake` only, never a real provider. Stop the servers by PID (`kill `), never by name. More recipes are in the graph-manager section of `TESTING.md`. **Validation.** ```bash npm run typecheck && npm run lint npm test -w graph-manager # and `npm test -w graph-execution` if you touched the engine ``` Known environment failure: `packages/graph-execution/src/cli.test.ts` "exits 2 at startup when --provider claude is not on the PATH" fails wherever a real `claude` is installed next to `node`. Ignore that one case only.
